annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: First Supplementary Card: Free for life. S$293.38 (inclusive of 9% GST) for second and subsequent card(s)
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 3% of current balance or $50, whichever is higher, plus any overdue amounts

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income: Minimum annual income of S$120,000 is required
minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income: Minimum annual income of S$120,000 is required

our_takes.our-take: The UOB Visa Infinite Metal Card targets high-income earners who prioritize travel and dining perks. The 2.4 miles per S$1 overseas and unlimited lounge access (plus one guest) are valuable for frequent travelers. A significant hurdle is the S$100,000 annual spend required to unlock the 15,000 loyalty bonus miles upon renewal. While the welcome and annual bonus miles are attractive, the S$654 annual fee without waiver and high spending requirement make it suitable only for those with substantial and consistent spending habits. Consider alternatives if you spend less or prefer cashback.
our_takes.good-for:
Affluent individuals seeking premium travel benefits, such as complimentary lounge access and travel insurance for enhanced travel experiences.
High-spending professionals aiming to maximize air miles on both local and overseas transactions to redeem for flights and upgrades.
Loyal customers who spend over S$100,000 annually, seeking bonus miles and ongoing rewards to offset the annual fee.
our_takes.things-to-note:
$654 annual fee is non-waivable; ensure the card's benefits justify the cost each year.
A S$100,000 spend is needed for the loyalty bonus, potentially unachievable for some users.
High 27.8% interest means carrying a balance can lead to significant debt accumulation quickly.
